alternativeTitles: Tease Me Harder: A Sweet and Kinky Romance
items.description: Yuka, a university student, and Mahiro, a working man, have been dating for six months. They are so pure that they are nervous to even hug each other. But one day, Yuka's precious secret that she didn't want him to know about is revealed, and their relationship slowly starts to go weird!
items.title: Ijimete-gokko.

alternativeTitles: いじめてくれる君がすき
I Like You Because You Bully Me
items.description:
Yuzuru Tachibana, a high school girl with family problems, was frustrated by her unsuccessful days.

One day, she overheard her classmate, Kae Shijima, talking about her father buying her an expensive coat, and Yuzuru made her her target for bullying.

For a while, Yuzuru enjoyed the bullying, but when her friends warned her that she'd be expelled if they found out, she lost interest and stopped.

However—even though she was no longer directing the bullying, Kae suddenly wet herself during class…
items.title: Ijimete Kureru Kimi ga Suki

alternativeTitles: Bắt nạt và bị bắt nạt
items.description:
Himeri Shishido is a tough, popular delinquent girl with high confidence in her strength.
She spends her days harassing Ui Odagiri, an otaku girl in her class, with the excuse of just "playing around".
However, something unexpected will put them into a secret relationship!
May it be Violence? Or maybe a Master & Slave relationship? Anything can happen in this bullying love story!~
items.title: Ijimete Ijirarete

alternativeTitles: 悪役令嬢はヒロインを虐めている場合ではない
This Isn't the Time for the Villainess to Be Bullying the Heroine
This is No Time for the Villainess to Bully the Heroine!
items.description: In an unexpected turn of events, Haru transmigrates into the body of Reina, the villainess of an otome game. As soon as she transmigrates, an event in which the villainess bullies the heroine starts. If she bullies the heroine just like the game, the only ending waiting for Reina will be one of destruction. This isn’t the time to be acting like a villainess, I want to enjoy my life! That’s what Reina decided, but the heroine and the game’s love interests keep falling into trouble?!
items.title: Akuyaku Reijou wa Heroine wo Ijimete iru Baai dewanai
